summary: Revalidated Sigma Lithium against its SEC-filed Q1 2026 MD&A, the latest July production and environmental update, and current 2026-07-27 market and FX data. Second-quarter production beat guidance, but USD 3.9 million of March cash, USD 133.9 million of debt, USD 144.5 million of negative working capital, a going-concern disclosure, material control weaknesses, unresolved funding, and no supportable valuation make the low-confidence security ineligible.
